events.title: Treaty of Purandar
events.summary: Upton–Poona agreement annuls Surat arrangement and pensions Raghoba.

events.title: Annual revenue settlements resumed
events.summary: Hastings replaces failed five-year farming with annual settlements.

events.title: Danish Crown assumes possessions
events.summary: Company administration replaced; final transfer to British follows in 1845.

events.title: France joins American war against Britain
events.summary: French links at Poona intensify Company's intervention concerns.

events.title: Company captures Mahe
events.summary: Threatens Hyder's French military-supply connection; immediate Second Mysore War setting.

events.title: Crompton's spinning mule
events.summary: Another key textile-mechanisation innovation.

events.title: Talegaon/Wadgaon defeat and convention
events.summary: Marathas compel Bombay army's surrender; Hastings rejects the terms.

events.title: Battle of Pollilur
events.summary: Mysorean victory over Colonel Baillie's force.

events.title: Goddard captures Ahmedabad and Bassein
events.summary: Company recovers ground in First Maratha War.

events.title: Popham captures Gwalior
events.summary: Correct year is 1780, not the chapter's 1781.

events.title: Second Anglo-Mysore War
events.summary: Hyder, then Tipu, face Company; ends by mutual restoration, not decisive British conquest.

events.title: Camac's Sipri campaign
events.summary: Military pressure assists negotiations with Scindia.

events.title: Battle of Porto Novo
events.summary: Eyre Coote defeated Hyder; distinguish from Pollilur's Mysorean victory.

events.title: Suffren brings French naval support
events.summary: French assistance in Second Mysore War.

events.title: Treaty of Salbai
events.summary: Madhav Rao II recognised; Raghoba pensioned; British retain Salsette/Elephanta, return most conquests.

events.title: Hyder dies; Tipu succeeds
events.summary: Tipu continues Second Anglo-Mysore War.

events.title: American war ends
events.summary: European settlement reduces French support and encourages Mysore–Company peace.

events.title: Bara Imambara built
events.summary: Asaf-ud-Daulah's Lucknow patronage.

events.title: Treaty of Mangalore
events.summary: Mutual restoration of territories and prisoners.

events.title: Cartwright's power loom
events.summary: Mechanisation of weaving complements spinning innovations.

events.title: Tipu restricts pepper/cardamom exports
events.summary: Commercial control challenges English interests on Malabar Coast.

events.title: Cornwallis's first governorship
events.summary: Third Mysore War, Permanent Settlement and Cornwallis Code.

events.title: Tipu asserts Padshah status
events.summary: Independent coinage/calendar/khutba and Ottoman recognition efforts.

events.title: Ghulam Qadir blinds Shah Alam II
events.summary: Mahadji restores emperor later in the year.

events.title: Tipu forbids dealings with English traders
events.summary: Commerce and sovereignty disputes intensify.

events.title: Tipu attacks Travancore's defences
events.summary: Nedumkotta assault, renewed in 1790, triggers Third Mysore War.

events.title: Decennial revenue settlement
events.summary: Cornwallis recognises zamindar proprietorship; made permanent in 1793.

events.title: Third Anglo-Mysore War
events.summary: Cornwallis, Nizam and Marathas defeat Tipu; half-territory settlement.

events.title: Ranjit Singh takes Sukerchakia leadership
events.summary: Beginning of his consolidation before Lahore and Maharaja title.

events.title: Treaty of Seringapatam
events.summary: Half territory ceded; ₹3.3 crore indemnity; two sons held as hostages.

events.title: John Shore's governorship
events.summary: Non-intervention orientation; not John Lawrence's later Afghan policy.

events.title: Permanent Settlement and Cornwallis Code
events.summary: Fixed State revenue demand; revenue/judicial separation and court reforms.

events.title: Mahadji Scindia dies
events.summary: Daulat Rao succeeds; Perron's later command belongs to this successor's period.

events.title: Battle of Kharda
events.summary: Marathas versus Nizam; comparison in the chapter's PYQ recall.

events.title: British take Fort Kochi
events.summary: Princely Cochin kingdom distinct from the directly controlled Fort Kochi settlement.

events.title: Madhav Rao II dies
events.summary: Court instability precedes Baji Rao II's accession.

events.title: Travancore capital shifts
events.summary: Padmanabhapuram to Thiruvananthapuram.

events.title: Baji Rao II as Peshwa
events.summary: Last Peshwa; Bassein, two wars and pension at Bithoor.

events.title: Hyderabad subsidiary alliance
events.summary: Nizam's French corps disbanded; expanded agreement follows in 1800.

events.title: Napoleon's Egyptian expedition
events.summary: Raises concern over French approach to India.

events.title: Richard Wellesley's governorship
events.summary: Subsidiary alliances, Fourth Mysore and Second Maratha wars.

events.title: Company assumes Tanjore administration
events.summary: Distinguish takeover of administration from a simple standard alliance.

events.title: Fourth Anglo-Mysore War
events.summary: Company armies under Harris advance on Tipu's capital.

events.title: Ranjit Singh takes Lahore
events.summary: Important step towards a consolidated Punjab kingdom.

events.title: Wadiyar restoration and Mysore subsidiary treaty
events.summary: Krishnaraja III installed with Purnaiah; restored State dependent on Company.

events.title: Seringapatam stormed; Tipu killed
events.summary: Mysore's independent military challenge ends; partition follows.

events.title: Company assumes Surat administration
events.summary: Another form of subordinated territorial control.

events.title: Expanded Hyderabad subsidiary arrangement
events.summary: Further territorial/fiscal dependence on Company.

events.title: Nana Phadnavis dies
events.summary: Poona's factional instability deepens.

events.title: Awadh subsidiary alliance
events.summary: Fiscal/territorial concessions reinforce British control.

events.title: Company assumes Carnatic administration
events.summary: Distinct from earlier Nawabship and Carnatic Wars.

events.title: Napoleon–Russia India scheme
events.summary: Later plan cannot explain the earlier 1799 Mysore war.

events.title: Ranjit Singh becomes Maharaja
events.summary: Sikh consolidation advances beyond misl leadership.

events.title: Vithoji Holkar executed
events.summary: Peshwa–Holkar antagonism leads to 1802 conflict.

events.title: Ranjit Singh takes Amritsar
events.summary: Consolidates a major Sikh religious and political centre.

events.title: Holkar defeats Peshwa/Scindia at Poona
events.summary: Baji Rao II flees and seeks Company protection.

events.title: Treaty of Bassein
events.summary: Peshwa accepts subsidiary alliance; triggers resistance from Scindia/Bhonsle.

events.title: Company captures Aligarh, Delhi and Agra
events.summary: Lake defeats Scindia's northern forces; Shah Alam II again under Company protection.

events.title: Second Anglo-Maratha War
events.summary: Separate campaigns and treaties undermine confederacy coordination.

events.title: Battle of Assaye
events.summary: Arthur Wellesley defeats Scindia/Bhonsle forces in Deccan.

events.title: Battle of Argaon
events.summary: Further Deccan defeat of Scindia/Bhonsle forces.

events.title: Battle of Laswari
events.summary: Lake defeats Scindia's northern army.

events.title: Gawilgarh captured
events.summary: Completes a key phase of the Deccan campaign.

events.title: Treaty of Deogaon
events.summary: Bhonsle cedes Cuttack/Balasore and west-Wardha territory; Resident accepted.

events.title: Treaty of Surji-Arjangaon
events.summary: Scindia cedes major holdings including Ganga–Yamuna doab.

events.title: Holkar–Company war
events.summary: Monson's defeat; Delhi defended; later British victories at Deeg/Farrukhabad.

events.title: Burhanpur agreement
events.summary: Further Scindia–Company subsidiary arrangements.

events.title: Wellesley recalled
events.summary: Cornwallis briefly returns, then Barlow pursues retrenchment.

events.title: Treaty of Rajpurghat
events.summary: Peace with Holkar; much territory restored, northern claims relinquished.

events.title: Akbar II's reign
events.summary: Ram Mohan Roy sent to Britain; imperial name removed from Company coinage in 1835.

events.title: Treaty of Amritsar
events.summary: Ranjit constrained south of Sutlej; cis-Sutlej chiefs under British protection.

events.title: Pindari raids in Mirzapur/Shahabad
events.summary: Part of growing raids on Company territories.

events.title: Charter Act ends Indian trade monopoly
events.summary: Tea and China trade remain exceptions until 1833.

events.title: Lord Hastings's governorship
events.summary: Nepal, Pindaris and Third Maratha War consolidate paramountcy.

events.title: Anglo-Nepal War
events.summary: One of Lord Hastings's expansion campaigns.

events.title: Gangadhar Shastri murdered at Pandharpur
events.summary: Gaekwad envoy's death and Trimbakji case intensify Peshwa–Company conflict.

events.title: Pindaris raid Northern Circars
events.summary: Provides justification for a major Company campaign.

events.title: Raghuji II dies; Nagpur succession conflict
events.summary: Parsoji/Appa Sahib dispute facilitates Resident Jenkins's intervention.

events.title: Treaty of Nagpur
events.summary: Appa Sahib accepts subsidiary force and dependence.

events.title: Pindari suppression
events.summary: Hastings's northern and Hislop's Deccan armies disperse raiding bands.

events.title: Third Anglo-Maratha War
events.summary: Final campaign ends Peshwaship and breaks the confederacy.

events.title: Treaty of Poona
events.summary: Further cessions/restrictions; Peshwa renounces confederacy leadership.

events.title: Battle of Khadki/Kirkee
events.summary: Peshwa defeated after attacking Poona residency.

events.title: Treaty of Gwalior
events.summary: Scindia agrees to assist anti-Pindari campaign and remains outside main anti-British war.

events.title: Battle of Sitabaldi
events.summary: Bhonsle forces defeated near Nagpur.

events.title: Battle of Mahidpur
events.summary: Hislop's forces defeat Holkar.

events.title: Dependent Satara kingdom created
events.summary: Pratap Singh, Shivaji's descendant, installed in a remnant kingdom.

events.title: Battle of Koregaon
events.summary: Company detachment resists larger Peshwa force; not his final surrender.

events.title: Treaty of Mandsaur
events.summary: Holkar accepts subsidiary dependence and territorial concessions.

events.title: Battle of Ashti
events.summary: Peshwa's commander Bapu Gokhale killed.

events.title: Baji Rao II surrenders to Malcolm
events.summary: Peshwaship abolished; pension at Bithoor; territories enlarge Bombay Presidency.

events.title: Munro becomes Madras governor
events.summary: Extends Ryotwari direct settlements, building on earlier work with Read.

events.title: Regulation VII and Mahalwari framework
events.summary: Holt Mackenzie's village/mahal-based revenue arrangements.

events.title: Company's remaining commercial activities end
events.summary: Tea/China monopoly ends; governing role continues until 1858.

events.title: Company coinage drops Mughal emperor's name
events.summary: Shows erosion of symbolic imperial authority under Akbar II.

events.title: Bahadur Shah II/Zafar's reign
events.summary: Poet-emperor becomes symbolic sovereign for 1857 rebels.

events.title: Tripartite Treaty
events.summary: Ranjit Singh, Company and Shah Shuja; Afghan restoration plans.

events.title: Ranjit Singh dies
events.summary: Succession conflict weakens the Punjab kingdom.

events.title: Kharak Singh and Nau Nihal Singh die
events.summary: Date is 1840, not 1839; deepens succession instability.

events.title: Danish possessions sold to British
events.summary: Tranquebar and Serampore transferred.

events.title: First Anglo-Sikh War
events.summary: Weakening court/army coordination precedes further conflict.

events.title: Satara annexed
events.summary: Doctrine-of-lapse chronology in supplied PYQ explanation.

events.title: Battle of Chillianwala
events.summary: Company versus Sikhs; not Dalhousie versus Marathas.

events.title: Punjab annexed after Second Anglo-Sikh War
events.summary: Sikh kingdom absorbed into British rule.

events.title: Sambalpur annexed
events.summary: After Satara, before Jhansi in the PYQ sequence.

events.title: Jhansi annexation decision/implementation
events.summary: Date convention varies; chronological position follows Satara and Sambalpur.

events.title: Awadh annexed
events.summary: Long dependence ends in direct annexation.

events.title: Revolt; Zafar becomes symbolic sovereign
events.summary: Company retakes Delhi and captures the emperor.

events.title: Zafar tried and deported to Rangoon
events.summary: Mughal dynasty's political removal distinct from his death in 1862.

events.title: Queen Victoria's Proclamation
events.summary: Crown takeover from Company; not the beginning of Mughal decline.

events.title: Bahadur Shah Zafar dies
events.summary: Death in exile after the dynasty's removal.

events.title: French enclaves transfer de facto to India
events.summary: Distinguish practical transfer from 1962 legal transfer.

events.title: Goa, Daman and Diu brought under India
events.summary: Military action ends Portuguese administration.

events.title: French enclave transfer de jure
events.summary: Legal completion follows de facto transfer of 1954.
